title: Logo Proportions
slide_intent: Show how a signature and a short headline can share one card while the headline remains the message a viewer reads first.
strategic_value: The half-height relationship can leave enough room for a distinctive delivery headline and an appetizing image.
demonstration: A cream delivery-status card places a small Instacart wordmark above the headline about risen bread. A photograph of a person holding a baked pie occupies the other half. The rail identifies the logo as half the headline height.
practical_value: Use this worked example when a short headline and an image compete for attention in the same layout.

content_islands.name: Ratio note
content_islands.spec: State the half-height relationship in a short note on the dark green left rail.

content_islands.name: Delivery card
content_islands.spec: Align the wordmark above the status eyebrow, two-line headline and notification button on cream. Place the large pie photograph at right.
